description: Elastic constants: DFT 0K clamped-ion, MLIP 300K unit cell, MLIP 300K 2x2x1 SC, MLIP 600K snapshot (paper)

dft_0K_clamped_ion._version: v1 (legacy, ordered-Li 0K, energy-curvature C_ii + cubic-symmetry C12 from BM K)
dft_0K_clamped_ion.method: QE finite strain ±0.005, 6 patterns x pos/neg = 12 SCF, kbar->GPa, QE sign flip
dft_0K_clamped_ion.notes: Ordered Li -> cooperative shear -> C44 overestimated. Reference only, NOT for paper. For paper-quality finite-T values, see mlip_600K_snapshot (also v1 lineage) or the new dft_0K_clamped_ion_stress_strain_full_Cij (v3 lineage, annealed Li, full 6×6 Cij).

dft_0K_clamped_ion_stress_strain_full_Ci.method: QE finite strain ±0.005, 12 SCF (6 Voigt patterns × ±h), full 6×6 Cij extracted from stress tensor σ = -(1/V) ∂E/∂ε with QE sign flip. Off-diagonal C12/C13/C23 measured directly via the column-by-column approach (one strain SCF gives one Cij column). No external bulk modulus K needed.
dft_0K_clamped_ion_stress_strain_full_Ci.advantage_over_energy_method: Energy curvature only recovers diagonal Voigt C_ii. Stress-strain gives the full 6×6 matrix in the same 12 SCFs, including the off-diagonal cross-coupling, with a built-in cross-check (Cij = Cji symmetry).

vs_modelc_v1_DFT_clamped_ion.interpretation: C11/K consistent with modelc v1 → same composition confirmed. C44/G/E reduced by ~30-50% → modelC_v3 likely captures Li-disorder basin (no longer ordered 0K minimum). C44=14.4 is very close to modelc_v2_mlip_600K C44=12.9, supporting interpretation that v3 represents the thermally-accessible Li configuration ensemble.

vs_modelc_v2_mlip_600K.C44_match_GPa: 14.4 (DFT v3) vs 12.9 (MLIP 600K) → 12% delta, within MLIP-DFT typical agreement
vs_modelc_v2_mlip_600K.K_match_GPa: 44.47 (DFT v3) vs 23.4 (MLIP 600K) → 90% delta — MLIP underestimates bulk modulus; expected discrepancy at finite-T MD-quenched configurations

mlip_300K_unit_cell.method: MACE CPU, 300K Langevin 5ps -> quench -> relaxed-ion Cij

mlip_300K_supercell_2x2x1.method: MACE, 2x2x1 SC (208-248 atoms), 300K MD -> quench -> Cij

mlip_600K_snapshot._version: v1 (legacy MACE, ordered-Li 0K starting structure → 600 K MD)
mlip_600K_snapshot._lineage_note: comp1-5, modelc rows below all START from v1 ordered-Li structures. For modelC_v3 (annealed Li + DFT-relaxed V0), see mlip_600K_snapshot_v3 section below.
mlip_600K_snapshot.method: MACE, 600K MD 10-18ps -> 5 snapshots -> quench -> FIRE relax -> finite-strain Cij -> VRH avg +/- SD

results.notes: Sign-corrected. Cl-only, highest E! v1 ordered-Li start; superseded by modelc_v3 once new MLIP 600K snapshot (Pipeline v2 §8e v3) finishes.

mlip_600K_snapshot.trend: With ModelC: ModelC(32.6) > comp1(29.1) > comp2(28.6) > comp3(27.3) > comp4(26.4) > comp5(25.8). Br up E down, Cl-only = most rigid.

mlip_600K_snapshot_v3._version: v3 (modelC_v3 only — annealed Li, DFT-relaxed V0 starting structure)
mlip_600K_snapshot_v3._purpose: Re-run of MLIP 600K snapshot starting from modelC_v3 V0. Same composition (Li5.4PS4.4Cl1.6) as modelc in v1 row above but DIFFERENT MLIP (UMA-s-1p1 foundation model, NOT MACE) and different starting structure.
mlip_600K_snapshot_v3.method: UMA-s-1p1 (task=omat) Langevin 600 K, equilib 10 ps + prod 20 ps, 5 snapshots, FIRE quench (fmax 0.01), per-strain FIRE RELAXED-ION Cij (fmax 0.05) full 6×6, no QE sign flip (FAIRChem returns physical-convention stress).

results.strain_ion_method: per-strain FIRE relax (fmax 0.05) — true finite-T elastic

vs_v1_modelc_MACE_600K.interpretation: UMA-s-1p1 foundation model gives systematically stiffer shear modulus than custom-trained MACE for LPSCl. Bulk modulus closer to DFT clamped-ion (44.5) than MACE (23.4).

vs_v3_DFT_0K_clamped.K_pct: -32.7% (DFT 44.47 → MLIP 600K 29.94) — Li disorder + thermal softening of bulk modulus
vs_v3_DFT_0K_clamped.G_pct: +9.0% (DFT 20.05 → MLIP 21.85) — UMA slightly stiffer than DFT in shear
vs_v3_DFT_0K_clamped.E_pct: +0.8% (DFT 52.30 → MLIP 52.72) — Young's modulus nearly invariant 0K-clamped vs 600K-relaxed
vs_v3_DFT_0K_clamped.Zener_delta: +0.72 (DFT 0.42 → MLIP 1.14) — Li disorder + thermal averaging restores cubic isotropy

dft_0K_clamped.key_finding: C44 most sensitive: 47% change from single Li hop. Shear >> compression sensitivity.

deng2016_reference.notes: DFT SQS method. C44 lower than our 0K ordered but E also lower.

intrinsic_vs_extrinsic.extrinsic_expt: Li5.4 > Li6 REVERSED due to GB pinning by vacancy
intrinsic_vs_extrinsic.within_family: Br up -> E down in both calc and expt
intrinsic_vs_extrinsic.cross_family: Vacancy -> GB pinning -> polycrystal stiffer -> trend reversal
